text:
alex c: Heads up — we need ND-series GPU quota + capacity reservation in West Europe for a burst job next week. Planning window: 2026-03-25 to 2026-04-02.

sophie ng: How many nodes / GPUs? which SKU? :eyes:

alex c: Target: ND96as_v4 (A100 80GB) x8 nodes (8*8 = 64 GPUs). Fallback: ND40rs_v2 or NC24rs_v3 if ND not available. Also need increase of network SCUs and accelerated networking limits for the subnet.

jia liu: Can you paste the subscription + current quota? I'll open the support ticket and loop our account rep.

alex c: sub: 3f2a-9b7c-xxxx-2026 (internal ref). Current quota shows 0 ND family in West Europe. Request payload I'm going to submit: 

```json
{
  "subscriptionId": "3f2a-9b7c-xxxx-2026",
  "region": "westeurope",
  "sku": "ND96as_v4",
  "currentQuota": "0",
  "requestedQuota": "8",
  "reason": "Scheduled inference + eval runs for Redwood Optimize; short-term burst reserve 2026-03-25 to 2026-04-02",
  "preferredReserveStart": "2026-03-25",
  "preferredReserveEnd": "2026-04-02"
}
```

alex c: Estimated cost (on-demand) ~ $13.5k/day for 8x ND96as_v4, reservation pricing TBD — we should ask account team for capacity pricing.

infra-bot: Created support request #2100345678 and attached quota payload. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/SupportRequestBlade/overview/requestId/2100345678

azure-support-bot: Support ticket 2100345678 received. Internal capacity check in progress. Estimated SLA for response: 24 hours.

jia liu: Marking this P1 for account escalation — @sophie ng can you ping our account rep (alex.h@azure) and ask about cross-region pooling (West Europe + North Europe) for guaranteed capacity?

sophie ng: Pinged account rep — asked for options: (1) short-term capacity reservation in WEU, (2) mix WEU+NEU with transparent routing, or (3) temporary spill to EastUS for the run. Waiting reply. :email:

azure-support-bot: Quick update on 2100345678: ND96as_v4 availability is constrained in West Europe. We can provision 4 nodes starting 2026-03-25. For full 8-node capacity, we recommend either (a) cross-region reservation (WEU + NEU), or (b) change SKU to ND40rs_v2 which has better immediate availability. Account team escalation required for large capacity block.

alex c: If WEU can only do 4, we'll do 4 ND96 + 4 ND40 fallback. Can you ask for temporary quota increases for both SKUs and network limits? Also need subnet accelerated networking quota upped to 64 accelerated NICs.

jia liu: Opening escalation ticket #2100346790 to request cross-region reservation + accelerated networking increase. Adding account rep and infra lead to CC.

infra-bot: Escalation #2100346790 created and linked to 2100345678. Notifying account team.

alex c: Action items: 1) sophie to confirm account rep availability & pricing. 2) jia to push escalation and request network NIC quota to 64. 3) i'll prepare Terraform plan with two SKUs and dynamic routing rule. Track tickets 2100345678 + 2100346790.

sophie ng: Confirmed — account rep asked for expected run hours and committed spend for reservation pricing. Asking for a ballpark number from you, alex.

alex c: Ballpark: 8 nodes * 24h * 8 days * ~$400/node/hr = ~ $614k (rough). We'll refine — this is to get reservation pricing only.

azure-support-bot: Escalation accepted. Account team will propose pricing and capacity options in next 48 hours.

jia liu: I'll also add a temporary fallback plan to switch traffic to our AWS accounts (pinned images + pre-warmed AMIs) if Azure can't meet full capacity.

alex c: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. I'll attach the Terraform snippets and subnet IDs to the escalation ticket in the portal. :thumbsup:

sophie ng: Nice. Please update tickets and ping here once account team responds.

alex c: will do.
